gaps.sentence: She explained the process ___ (PATIENT) to each visitor.

gaps.sentence: The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.
